reasoning: The request is a single still-to-motion animation with no dialogue, no lettering, and no prohibitions. The uploaded image is a multi-panel character reference sheet, so its turnaround panels, labels, and charcoal studio backdrop are presentation only; the redrawn scene takes the subject's observed identity and all-black wardrobe (fully preserved by the licence) and places him on the rain-soaked nighttime rooftop environment actually depicted in the sheet's hero panel, under its low-key cool blue-gray light with warm amber bokeh. The explicit 16:9 animated-photo target governs framing and medium, so no reference-sheet layout or visible labels carry over. Motion stays slow and drifting within the 5167ms target, split into two non-repeating beats: an establishing drift on the standing profile, then a closer arc as he shifts his weight and lifts his gaze. Balanced creativity permits ambience but the scope blocks speak, music, and on-screen text, so only diegetic rain and city sound appear.

Rain streaks drift slowly through the cool blue-gray night air and wet paving mirrors the distant amber city bokeh behind metal railings; he settles his weight onto his back foot and lets his shoulders ease down.

shots.what_changes: The still frame begins moving as rain drifts across the rooftop and the man shifts his weight and lowers his shoulders.

shots.action: Holding the same rain-soaked rooftop, the camera drifts around him as he turns his head from the left profile toward the lens, brow furrowing faintly over the scarred eyebrow, breath faintly visible in the cold air; the water beads on the jacket collar catch the amber bokeh and the bun at the back of his head comes into view at the arc's end.
